name: ussd_catalog_offer_group
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ussd_catalog_offer_group(p_network text, p_family_code text, p_title text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_network='moov' and (
      regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_family_code,'')),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')='folie'
      or regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_title,'')),'[^a-z0-9]+',' ','g') ~ '(^| )(moov *)?folie( |$)') then 'folie'
    when p_network='mtn' and (
      regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_family_code,'')),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')='cchic'
      or regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_title,'')),'[^a-z0-9]+',' ','g') ~ '(^| )c *chic( |$)') then 'cchic'
    else null end;
$function$

name: ussd_secret_revision
ussd_secret_settings
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ussd_secret_settings(p_network text, p_actor text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select jsonb_build_object('value',c.secret_code,
      'revision',c.revision::text)
    from private.ussd_secret_configuration c where c.network=p_network and c.actor_scope in (p_actor,'both')
    order by (c.actor_scope=p_actor) desc limit 1),
    jsonb_build_object('value',private.ussd_default_secret(),'revision','default-v1'));
$function$

name: ussd_variable_name
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ussd_variable_name(p_token text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v text:=translate(lower(p_token),
  'àáâãäåçèéêëìíîïñòóôõöùúûüýÿ','aaaaaaceeeeiiiinooooouuuuyy');
begin
  v:=regexp_replace(v,U&'[\0300-\036f]','','g');
  return case
    when v in ('msisdn_local','numero_du_destinataire','numero','beneficiaire') then 'msisdn_local'
    when v in ('amount','montant') then 'amount'
    when v in ('offer_code','code_offre','code offre') then 'offer_code'
    when v in ('quantity','quantite') then 'quantity'
    when v in ('secret_code','code_secret','code secret') then 'secret_code'
    else null end;
end $function$
